# report-kit

**The backend that turns lab results into print-ready A4 reports, as PDF or HTML.**

Navy Sidebar and classic designs · header and pre-printed paper variants · 31 tests · scannable barcode and QR · no browser needed

[![Backend](https://img.shields.io/badge/side-backend-14264A)](#)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-14264A?logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](#)
[![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-strict-14264A?logo=typescript&logoColor=white)](#)
[![Next.js · Fastify · Express](https://img.shields.io/badge/runs%20in-Next.js%20·%20Fastify%20·%20Express%20·%20Hono-C2410C)](#mount-it-anywhere)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-All%20rights%20reserved-E9A23B)](LICENSE)

## Why

The lab used to produce reports by hand-editing Word files, one copy per test. `report-kit` replaces that with
data → document:

- **Data in, A4 out.** You send a patient and their results; the backend returns a PDF or HTML page.
- **Accurate by construction.** H/L flags come from the reference range, male/female ranges are picked
  automatically, and long reports split across pages with *Page X of Y*.
- **Prints the same everywhere.** HTML and PDF share one geometry file and one row-height model, so they
  break pages in exactly the same places.
- **Backend only.** Rendering, fonts, images and PDF generation run in Node.js. Your frontend stays
  free to look however you want; it talks to this backend through [`@mgpl-diagnostics/client`](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/client).

## How it fits

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  subgraph Frontend["Your app (any UI)"]
    C["@mgpl-diagnostics/client<br/>headless SDK"]
  end
  subgraph Backend["Your backend (Node.js)"]
    A["createReportApi()<br/>or createMgplApi()"] --> R["report-kit<br/>templates · layout · react-pdf"]
    A --> I["invoice-kit<br/>billing"]
  end
  C -- "POST /report → PDF / HTML" --> A
  C -- "GET /templates" --> A
```

## Quick start

```bash
npm i @mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit react react-dom
```

<details>
<summary>Installing from GitHub Packages</summary>

```ini
# .npmrc
@mgpl-diagnostics:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com
//npm.pkg.github.com/:_authToken=${GITHUB_TOKEN}   # token with read:packages
```

or straight from git: `npm i github:mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit#v2.0.0` (built on install).
</details>

```ts
import { buildReport, renderReportPdf } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";

const report = buildReport(
  { title: "Mrs", name: "Kavita Sharma", age: 32, sex: "Female", patientId: "MGPL1025", refDoctor: "Self" },
  [
    { template: "cbc", results: { hb: "10.8", wbc: "6700", plt: "2.45" } },
    { template: "kft", results: { urea: "28", creatinine: "0.9" } },
  ],
);

const pdf: Buffer = await renderReportPdf({ report, variant: "header" }); // A4, ready to print or email
```

## Mount it anywhere

The HTTP API is a standard `(Request) => Response` handler, so it fits every Node.js backend:

<table>
<tr><th>Next.js (App Router)</th><th>Fastify</th></tr>
<tr>
<td>

```ts
// app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts
import { createReportApi } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";

const api = createReportApi({ basePath: "/api/mgpl" });
export { api as GET, api as POST, api as OPTIONS };
export const runtime = "nodejs";
```

</td>
<td>

```ts
import Fastify from "fastify";
import { mgplFastify } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit/fastify";

const app = Fastify();
await app.register(mgplFastify, { prefix: "/api/mgpl" });
await app.listen({ port: 4000 });
```

</td>
</tr>
<tr><th>Express / node:http</th><th>Hono · Bun · Deno</th></tr>
<tr>
<td>

```ts
import { createReportApi, toNodeHandler } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";

app.use("/api/mgpl", toNodeHandler(createReportApi()));
// mount before express.json()
```

</td>
<td>

```ts
const api = createReportApi({ basePath: "/api/mgpl" });
app.all("/api/mgpl/*", (c) => api(c.req.raw));      // Hono
Bun.serve({ fetch: api });                           // Bun
```

</td>
</tr>
</table>

Need invoices too? Mount [`createMgplApi()` from invoice-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit) instead. It serves every report route as well.

## HTTP API

| Method & route | Body / query | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /templates` | | every test with its result fields + profiles (build entry forms from it) |
| `POST /report` | `{ patient, tests }` · `{ patient, profile }` · `{ report }` + `variant`, `design`, `format` | PDF (default) or HTML |
| `GET /letterhead` | `?format=pdf\|html` | blank stationery |
| `GET /assets/*` | | fonts and images used by the HTML output (cached for a year) |
| `GET /samples` | | demo reports, only with `samples: true` |
| `GET /health` | | `{ ok: true }` |

Errors are JSON `{ "error": "…" }` with `400` (bad input), `404`, `405`, `413` (body too large) or `500`.
`OPTIONS` preflight and `cors` are built in for frontends on another origin.

## Tests and profiles

| Department | Templates |
|---|---|
| **Hematology** | CBC · Haemoglobin · ESR · Blood group · Malaria (card) · BT/CT · PT/INR |
| **Biochemistry** | Blood sugar (F/PP/R) · HbA1c · LFT · RFT · KFT · Electrolytes · Lipid · Iron profile · single tests |
| **Immunoassay** | Thyroid (T3/T4/TSH/FT3/FT4) · Vitamin D · Vitamin B12 · PSA |
| **Serology** | Dengue · HIV/HBsAg/VDRL/HCV · Widal · Typhidot · Malaria antigen · CRP/ASO · RA factor |
| **Clinical pathology** | Urine routine · Urine pregnancy · Stool · Semen analysis |

**Profiles:** Fever · Diabetes · Liver & Kidney · Anaemia · Antenatal · Pre-operative · Full Body Check-up.

A result is either a string (`"10.8"`) or `{ value, flag?, range?, unit?, method? }`. Numeric results are
flagged **H/L** automatically. Use `flag: "abnormal"` for text results such as *Positive*.

## Configuration

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Lab name, address, phone, email, signatory, footer lines | [`src/server/lab.ts`](src/server/lab.ts) (`MGPL_LAB`), or pass `lab` to any function |
| Logo, icons, QC stamp | replace files in [`assets/report-assets/`](assets/report-assets) (SVG or PNG) |
| **Real signature** | **never in git.** Set `MGPL_SIGNATURE_FILE` (or `MGPL_SIGNATURE_HEADER_FILE` / `MGPL_SIGNATURE_NONHEADER_FILE`) to a private image path on the server. The repo ships a placeholder. |
| QR verify link | `verifyBaseUrl` in the lab profile. Without it, the QR holds a plain-text summary. |
| CORS, body limit, demo samples | `createReportApi({ cors, maxBodyBytes, samples })` |

## Printing

| You want | Use | Printer setting |
|---|---|---|
| Pre-printed stationery | `GET /letterhead?format=pdf` | **Borderless**, Actual size |
| Report on plain paper | `variant: "header"` | Actual size |
| Report on stationery | `variant: "non-header"` | Actual size, paper guide snug |

## Project layout

```
src/server/      backend: templates, rendering (HTML + react-pdf), API, adapters
src/shared/      types + API contract
assets/          fonts (OFL), images, licences — shipped in the package
scripts/         smoke test, examples, asset sync
```

## Development

```bash
npm install          # also builds dist/ (prepare)
npm run typecheck
npm run smoke        # 156 renders: every sample × design × variant, HTML + PDF, text verified inside the PDFs
npm run examples     # examples/index.html — HTML + PDF of every sample
```

Read **[AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)** before changing layout or templates. It lists the invariants and the
react-pdf pitfalls this project has already hit. Full API: **[docs/api.md](docs/api.md)**. AI index: [llms.txt](llms.txt) · [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).

## File: docs/api.md

# API reference: @mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit (v2)

Backend only (Node.js ≥ 20). Positions are inches on A4 (8.27 × 11.69 in); font sizes are pt.
Browsers use [`@mgpl-diagnostics/client`](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/client).

Entry points:

| Import | Contents |
|---|---|
| `@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit` | everything below except the Fastify plugin |
| `@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit/fastify` | `mgplFastify` plugin (needs `fastify` ≥ 4 installed) |
| `@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit/assets/*` | `report-assets/*` images, `report-fonts/*.woff` |

## HTTP API

```ts
createReportApi(opts?: ApiOptions): (req: Request) => Promise<Response>

interface ApiOptions {
  basePath?: string;      // default "/api/mgpl"
  lab?: LabProfile;       // default defaultLab(): MGPL_LAB + MGPL_SIGNATURE_* env files
  samples?: boolean;      // expose GET /samples and { sample } requests (default false)
  cors?: string;          // Access-Control-Allow-Origin, e.g. "https://app.example.com" or "*"
  maxBodyBytes?: number;  // default 1_000_000
  publicUrl?: string;     // public URL of the API behind a proxy (used for asset links in HTML)
}
```

| Route | Notes |
|---|---|
| `GET /health` | `{ ok: true, service: "report-kit" }` |
| `GET /templates` | `TemplateCatalog`: `{ templates: TemplateInfo[], profiles }` |
| `GET /samples` | `SampleInfo[]` (only with `samples: true`, else 404) |
| `POST /report` | body `ReportRequest` → `application/pdf` (default) or `text/html` (`format: "html"`) |
| `GET /letterhead?format=pdf\|html&download=1` | blank stationery |
| `GET /assets/report-assets/<file>` · `/assets/report-fonts/<file>` | immutable, cacheable. HTML output links here. |
| `OPTIONS *` | 204 with CORS headers when `cors` is set |

Errors: JSON `{ error }` with 400 (validation), 404, 405, 413, 500.

```ts
interface ReportRequest {
  patient?: Patient;
  tests?: { template: TemplateId; results: Results }[];
  profile?: { id: ProfileId; results: Partial<Record<TemplateId, Results>> };
  report?: Report;          // an already built report
  sample?: string;          // demo id (samples: true)
  variant?: "header" | "non-header";   // default "header"
  design?: "sidebar" | "classic";      // default "sidebar"
  format?: "pdf" | "html";             // default "pdf"
  fileName?: string; download?: boolean;
}
```

### Mounting

```ts
// Next.js route handler: app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts
const api = createReportApi({ basePath: "/api/mgpl" });
export { api as GET, api as POST, api as OPTIONS };  export const runtime = "nodejs";

// Fastify
import { mgplFastify } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit/fastify";
await app.register(mgplFastify, { prefix: "/api/mgpl", cors: "*" });   // + any ApiOptions, or { handler }

// Express / Koa / node:http (mount before body parsers)
app.use("/api/mgpl", toNodeHandler(createReportApi()));

// Hono / Bun / Deno
app.all("/api/mgpl/*", (c) => api(c.req.raw));
```

Building blocks, for composing your own routes: `templateCatalog()`, `reportFromRequest(body, opts)`,
`labWithAssetUrls(lab, base)`, `serveAsset(path, cors?)`, `apiBaseUrl(req, opts)`, `json()`,
`pdfResponse()`, `htmlResponse()`, `readJson()`, `withCors()`, `HttpError`.

## Building reports

```ts
buildReport(patient: Patient, tests: TestInput[], opts?: { endText?: string }): Report
buildProfileReport(patient, profileId, results: Partial<Record<TemplateId, Results>>): Report

type Results = Record<string, ResultValue | string[] | undefined>
type ResultValue = string | { value?: string; flag?: Flag; range?: string | string[]; unit?: string; method?: string }
type Flag = "auto" | "normal" | "high" | "low" | "abnormal"
```

`TEMPLATES` (by id) and `PROFILES`:

| Category | Template ids |
|---|---|
| Hematology | `cbc` `hb` `esr` `blood-group` `mp` `bt-ct` `pt-inr` |
| Biochemistry | `blood-sugar` `hba1c` `lft` `rft` `kft` `electrolytes` `lipid` `iron-profile` `biochemistry` |
| Immunoassay | `thyroid` `vitamin-d` `vitamin-b12` `psa` |
| Serology | `dengue` `hiv-hbsag-vdrl` `widal` `typhidot` `malaria-antigen` `crp-aso` `ra-factor` |
| Clinical Pathology | `urine` `upt` `stool` `semen` |

Profiles: `fever-profile` `diabetes-profile` `liver-kidney-profile` `anemia-profile` `antenatal-profile`
`pre-operative-profile` `full-body-checkup`.

A `ReportTemplate` has `id`, `name`, `category`, `specimen`, `method`, `fields`, `build(results, { patient })`, `sample`.
"Only filled rows" templates (`blood-sugar`, `thyroid`, `hiv-hbsag-vdrl`, `crp-aso`, `biochemistry`)
print just the tests that have results.

## Rendering

```ts
renderReportPdf({ report, variant, design?, lab?, publicDir?, fontDir? }): Promise<Buffer>
renderLetterheadPdf({ lab?, publicDir?, fontDir? }?): Promise<Buffer>
renderReportHtml({ report, variant, design?, lab?, inline? = true, fontBase?, title? }): Promise<string>
renderLetterheadHtml({ lab?, inline?, fontBase? }?): Promise<string>
inlineLab(lab?, dir?): LabProfile   // /report-assets/* → data URIs
```

React documents (rendered on the server): `LabReport`, `SidebarReport`, `ReportDocument` (classic),
`SidebarLetterhead`, `SbLetterhead`; react-pdf: `SidebarReportPdf`, `ReportPdf`, `SidebarLetterheadPdf`, `SbLetterheadPdf`.
Helpers: `loadImage`, `svgToPng`, `registerFonts`, `assetsDir()`, `packageRoot()`.

## Lab profile and signatures

```ts
interface LabProfile {
  name; logoSrc; addressLines: string[]; email; phone;
  signatory: { name; designation; signatureHeaderSrc; signatureNonHeaderSrc };
  qcStampSrc?; icons: { emailSrc; phoneSrc };
  sidebarText?; footerLines?: string[]; verifyBaseUrl?;
  upiId?; gstin?; registrationNo?; invoiceTerms?: string[];   // used by invoice-kit
}

MGPL_LAB                      // the lab's branding, with a placeholder signature
defaultLab()                  // MGPL_LAB + real signatures from the environment
labFromEnv(lab?, env?)        // reads MGPL_SIGNATURE_FILE / _HEADER_FILE / _NONHEADER_FILE
withSignatureFiles(lab, { header?, nonHeader? })
imageFileToDataUri(path)
```

## Other exports

`resolveFlag(row)`, `formatDate`, `formatDateTime`, `formatDoctor`, `fullName`, `barcodeSvg(text, "code39" | "code128")`,
`qrSvg(text)`, `reportQrValue(report, lab)`, `sbLayoutPages`, `layoutPages`, `SIDEBAR_LAYOUT`, `LAYOUT`,
`sidebarCss`, `reportCss`, `SAMPLES`, `getSampleReport(id)`, and all types (`Patient`, `Report`, `Section`, `Row`, …).

## CLI

`npx mgpl-report-assets [dest=public]` copies `report-assets/` and `report-fonts/` into a static folder,
for apps that render the React documents themselves instead of using the API's `/assets` route.

## File: AGENTS.md

# AGENTS.md — @mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit

Instructions for AI coding agents (and humans) working on this repo. Read this before you change anything.

## What this is

The **backend** library (Node.js ≥ 20) that renders A4 pathology reports for MGPL Diagnostics. It has
**two renderers that must look identical**:

1. **HTML**: React components (`src/server/ReportDocument.tsx`, `src/server/sidebar/SidebarReport.tsx`)
2. **PDF**: react-pdf documents (`src/server/pdf/ReportPdf.tsx`, `src/server/sidebar/SidebarReportPdf.tsx`), pure Node.js

They are exposed over HTTP by `createReportApi()`, a standard `(Request) => Response` handler, with
adapters for Fastify (`/fastify` entry) and Express/node:http (`toNodeHandler`).

There are two designs (`sidebar` = Navy Sidebar, the default; `classic` = replica of the lab's old Word
files) and two variants (`header` prints the letterhead; `non-header` omits it for pre-printed paper,
**same positions for everything else**).

**There is no browser code here.** Frontends use `@mgpl-diagnostics/client`, a separate zero-dependency
repo. Do not add browser entry points, hooks or CSS-in-app UI to this package.

## Map

```
src/shared/            types.ts (data model) + api.ts (HTTP contract) — no runtime logic
src/server/index.ts    the package entry ("@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit")
src/server/fastify.ts  the "/fastify" entry (Fastify plugin; fastify is an optional peer)
src/server/
  api.ts               createReportApi: routes, validation, CORS, asset serving, errors
  node.ts              toNodeHandler for Express / node:http
  signatures.ts        real signatures from MGPL_SIGNATURE_* env files (never committed); defaultLab()
  lab.ts               MGPL_LAB branding (placeholder signature)
  templates/           31 test templates + PROFILES + buildReport/buildProfileReport
  format.ts barcode.ts qr.ts samples.ts paths.ts html.ts
  layout.ts measure.ts styles.ts ReportDocument.tsx pdf/      classic design + PDF pipeline
  sidebar/             Navy Sidebar: layout.ts (geometry), measure.ts (pagination), model.ts, styles.ts, renderers
assets/report-assets/  logo.svg, icons, qc-stamp.svg, signature-placeholder.svg, icon licence
assets/report-fonts/   *.woff + LICENSES/ (OFL) — the same files for HTML and PDF
scripts/               sync-assets.mjs, smoke-test.tsx, generate-examples.tsx
dist/                  build output — git-ignored; built by `prepare` and in CI
```

## Commands

```bash
npm run typecheck   # must pass
npm run build       # tsup → dist/ (git-ignored; also runs on install via "prepare")
npm run smoke       # REQUIRED before committing layout/template/renderer changes (~4 min)
npm run examples    # HTML + PDF for every sample → examples/ (git-ignored); look at them
npm run assets      # only when fonts/icons/stamp change
```

## Invariants: do not break these

1. **HTML and PDF must match.** Every position comes from `layout.ts` / `sidebar/layout.ts`, and every
   row height from `measure.ts` / `sidebar/measure.ts`. Never hard-code a size in one renderer only.
   If you add a visual element, add it to *both* renderers and to the layout constants.
2. **Pagination is computed, not measured.** `layoutPages` / `sbLayoutPages` decide page breaks from
   the row-height model. Both renderers set explicit heights from it. If you change a row's content,
   update its height function.
3. **Non-header = header minus letterhead.** Only the letterhead layer (sidebar, header, footer, and
   for classic the logo/address/rule) is conditional. Body, signature, page number: identical positions.
4. **Backend only, but the HTTP contract is shared.** Request/response shapes live in
   `src/shared/api.ts` and are mirrored in `@mgpl-diagnostics/client`; report-studio's
   `contract-check.ts` fails the build if they drift. Change both together.
5. **Components are pure** (no hooks, no `"use client"`), so they work in React Server Components and
   `renderToStaticMarkup`.

## react-pdf gotchas (each one has bitten this project)

- **Text that doesn't fit its box is silently dropped or truncated with "…".** It is not shown as
  overflow like in HTML. Size columns from measured text widths (the smoke test measures every
  string with fontkit) and give fixed-height rows `lineHeight: 1`.
- **A Text after another Text in a flex row can get zero width.** Give rows/cells explicit widths.
- **Missing glyph = crash** (e.g. a non-breaking space U+00A0 or `≥` crashed it). The smoke test
  checks that every printed character exists in the font. Write `>=`, not `≥`. There is no `₹` in
  Manrope, so money uses `Rs.`
- **No SVG images.** SVGs are rasterised with resvg (`svgToPng`) before going into `<Image>`.
- **Leading spaces in a `<Text>` are trimmed.** Put spaces at the end of the previous run.
- Only `.woff`/`.ttf` fonts; they are registered in `src/server/pdf/assets.ts`.

## How to…

**Add a test template**: add it in the right `src/server/templates/*.ts` with `panel({...})` (standard
Test/Result/Unit/Range) or a custom `build()`. Give it `specimen`, `sample` results and (if
needed) `rangeBySex`. Register it in `src/server/templates/index.ts` → `TEMPLATES`, and give it a `category`. Then run `npm run smoke`.
The fit check will tell you if a name/unit/range is too wide for a column.

**Change the Navy Sidebar layout**: edit `src/server/sidebar/layout.ts`. If row content changes, update
`src/server/sidebar/measure.ts`. Run smoke and `npm run examples` and look at the PDFs (render them to PNG to inspect).

**Change branding**: edit `src/server/lab.ts` and/or replace files in `assets/report-assets/`.
The contact email lives only there; update it in one place.

**Signatures**: never commit a real signature image. The package ships `signature-placeholder.svg`;
servers set `MGPL_SIGNATURE_FILE` (or `_HEADER_` / `_NONHEADER_`) to a private file, and `defaultLab()`
loads it as a data URI.

**Add an API route**: add it in `src/server/api.ts` (and `ROUTES` in `src/shared/api.ts`), mirror the
types and method in the client repo, and extend invoice-kit's `scripts/api-test.ts`.

**Reference ranges**: the classic templates copy the lab's Word files. Ranges of the newer tests are
standard adult values awaiting the pathologist's sign-off. Don't invent new medical ranges silently;
call them out.

## Testing standard

`npm run smoke` renders 39 samples × 2 designs × 2 variants as HTML **and** PDF, plus the letterhead,
and fails on any of these:
- page-count mismatch;
- a value missing from the HTML **or from the PDF text** (extracted with pdf.js);
- text not fitting its column;
- a missing glyph;
- a missing asset.

Keep it green. When you fix a rendering bug, add a check that would have caught it.

## Privacy and licence

Never commit real patient data or real signatures. The lab's original Word files and the signature
images live outside every repo on purpose. `samples.ts` uses fictional names. The code is "All rights
reserved" (see LICENSE). Bundled fonts and icons keep their own licences (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

## File: src/shared/types.ts

```ts
/** "header"     = full letterhead (logo, address, email/mobile footer) — for plain paper / PDF.
 *  "non-header" = top left blank for pre-printed letterhead paper; only QC stamp + signature. */
export type ReportVariant = "header" | "non-header";

/** "sidebar" = Navy Sidebar design (default); "classic" = replica of the original Word designs. */
export type ReportDesign = "sidebar" | "classic";

export interface Patient {
  /** Salutation before the name, e.g. "Mr", "Mrs", "Master", "Ku" */
  title?: string;
  name: string;
  /** e.g. 32 or "6 Month" */
  age: number | string;
  /** Default "Year(s)" */
  ageUnit?: string;
  sex: string;
  /** e.g. "MGPL398" — printed as a scannable Code 39 barcode (bwip-js) */
  patientId?: string;
  /** e.g. "Self", "A. Verma". "Dr. " is added unless it already starts with "Dr". */
  refDoctor?: string;
  /** Date or preformatted string; printed DD-MM-YYYY. Defaults to today. */
  sampleCollectionDate?: Date | string;
  /** Lab sample / accession number */
  sampleId?: string;
  /** Used on invoices */
  phone?: string;
  address?: string;
  /** e.g. "Whole Blood (EDTA)". Defaults to the specimens of the tests on the report. */
  sampleType?: string;
  /** Date or preformatted "12-10-2026 08:45 AM". Falls back to sampleCollectionDate. */
  collectedAt?: Date | string;
  registeredAt?: Date | string;
  reportedAt?: Date | string;
}

/** A piece of text with optional formatting. */
export interface TextRun {
  text: string;
  bold?: boolean;
  italic?: boolean;
  /** CSS colour, e.g. "#FF0000" */
  color?: string;
  /** Font size in pt */
  size?: number;
  font?: string;
}

export type Rich = string | TextRun | TextRun[];

export type Align = "left" | "center" | "right";

/** "auto" (default) compares a numeric result with the reference range. */
export type Flag = "auto" | "normal" | "high" | "low" | "abnormal";

export interface Column {
  /** "name" | "result" | "unit" | "range" for test rows; anything for `cells` rows */
  key: string;
  header: string;
  /** Width in inches */
  width: number;
  /** Alignment of the values */
  align?: Align;
  /** Alignment of the header text (defaults to `align`) */
  headerAlign?: Align;
  /** Extra left padding of values, inches */
  padLeft?: number;
  /** Extra left padding of the header text, inches (default 0.08 = Word cell margin) */
  headerPadLeft?: number;
  /** Header cell spans this many columns (e.g. "WIDAL TEST" over two columns) */
  headerSpan?: number;
}

/** Sub-heading inside a section, e.g. "COMPLETE BLOOD COUNT", "PHYSICAL EXAMINATION". */
export interface HeadingRow {
  kind: "heading";
  text: string;
  size?: number;
  color?: string;
}

/** Normal test line: name | result | unit | range */
export interface TestRow {
  kind: "test";
  /** Key used to fill results, e.g. "hb" */
  key?: string;
  name: string;
  /** Bold suffix after the name, e.g. "(HB)" */
  abbr?: string;
  result?: string;
  unit?: string;
  /** One line, or several lines (Lipid profile risk bands) */
  range?: string | string[];
  /** Sex-specific ranges; picked from the patient's sex when the report is built */
  rangeBySex?: { male: string; female: string };
  flag?: Flag;
  /** Override result colour */
  resultColor?: string;
  /** Italic method line under the test, e.g. "(Performed on Jmitra Rapid test.)" */
  method?: string;
}

/** Free cells, for grids like the Widal titre table and Semen analysis. */
export interface CellsRow {
  kind: "cells";
  cells: Rich[];
}

/** Full-width paragraph, e.g. "IMPRESSION – Reactive". */
export interface TextRow {
  kind: "text";
  content: Rich;
  /** Left indent, inches */
  indent?: number;
  /** Space before, pt */
  spaceBefore?: number;
}

export type Row = HeadingRow | TestRow | CellsRow | TextRow;

/** Typography + colour knobs for one section (each template sets these to match its design). */
export interface SectionStyle {
  /** Title size in pt (Arial Black). Default 12 */
  titleSize?: number;
  /** Title letter spacing in pt */
  titleSpacing?: number;
  /** Row font size in pt. Default 11 */
  fontSize?: number;
  /** Row font family override (Dengue / HIV use Arial) */
  font?: string;
  /** Heading row size in pt. Default 11 */
  headingSize?: number;
  /** Space after each row, pt. Default 6 */
  rowGap?: number;
  /** Min height of each row, pt */
  rowHeight?: number;
  nameBold?: boolean;
  nameSize?: number;
  /** Colour of in-range results. Default black. CBC uses "#00B0F0". */
  resultColor?: string;
  resultBold?: boolean;
  resultSize?: number;
  unitBold?: boolean;
  /** Font size for multi-line ranges, pt */
  rangeSize?: number;
  rangeFont?: string;
  rangeBold?: boolean;
  /** Abnormal results colour. Default "#FF0000" */
  abnormalColor?: string;
  /** Abnormal results bold. Default true */
  abnormalBold?: boolean;
  /** Method line size, pt */
  methodSize?: number;
  /** Space between a test and its method line, pt. Default 6 */
  methodGap?: number;
  /** Space after heading rows, pt (default = rowGap) */
  headingGap?: number;
  /** Row content left indent, inches */
  indent?: number;
}

export interface Section {
  /** Department title in the blue band, e.g. "HEMATOLOGY" */
  title: string;
  /** Test / panel name, e.g. "Complete Blood Count (CBC)". Set from the template. */
  subtitle?: string;
  /** e.g. "Whole Blood (EDTA)" */
  specimen?: string;
  /** e.g. "Automated Cell Counter" */
  method?: string;
  columns: Column[];
  /** Hide the column header row (Semen Analysis) */
  hideColumnHeader?: boolean;
  rows: Row[];
  /** Full report width like the title bar (CBC). Default = within page margins. */
  wide?: boolean;
  style?: SectionStyle;
  /** Start this section on a new A4 page */
  pageBreakBefore?: boolean;
}

/** Every image is just a URL: "/report-assets/logo.svg", "https://…", or a data: URI.
 *  Swap them in one place (lab.ts) — SVG and PNG both work. */
export interface LabProfile {
  name: string;
  logoSrc: string;
  addressLines: string[];
  email: string;
  phone: string;
  signatory: {
    name: string;
    designation: string;
    /** Signature on the header (letterhead) variant */
    signatureHeaderSrc: string;
    /** Signature on the non-header variant */
    signatureNonHeaderSrc: string;
  };
  qcStampSrc?: string;
  icons: { emailSrc: string; phoneSrc: string };
  /** Vertical text in the sidebar (Navy Sidebar design). Defaults to the lab name in capitals. */
  sidebarText?: string;
  /** Lines printed in the letterhead footer (Navy Sidebar design) */
  footerLines?: string[];
  /** If set, the QR code links to `${verifyBaseUrl}${sampleId ?? patientId}`; otherwise it
   *  encodes a plain-text summary of the report. */
  verifyBaseUrl?: string;
  /* ---- billing (invoice kit) ---- */
  /** UPI ID (VPA) for the "scan to pay" QR on invoices, e.g. "mgpl@okaxis" */
  upiId?: string;
  /** Printed on invoices when the lab is GST registered */
  gstin?: string;
  /** Clinical establishment / lab registration number */
  registrationNo?: string;
  /** Terms printed at the bottom of invoices */
  invoiceTerms?: string[];
}

export interface Report {
  patient: Patient;
  sections: Section[];
  /** Defaults to "--End of Report--" */
  endText?: string;
  /** Override what the QR code encodes */
  qrValue?: string;
}
```

## File: src/shared/api.ts

```ts
// The contract between the browser client and the backend API. Types + route names only —
// no rendering code lives here, so importing it costs nothing in a client bundle.
import type { ProfileId, Results, TemplateId } from "../server/templates";
import type { Patient, Report, ReportDesign, ReportVariant } from "./types";

export type { ProfileId, Results, TemplateId };

/** Default mount point of the backend handler */
export const DEFAULT_BASE_PATH = "/api/mgpl";

/** Routes, relative to the base path */
export const ROUTES = {
  health: "/health",
  templates: "/templates",
  samples: "/samples",
  report: "/report",
  letterhead: "/letterhead",
  assets: "/assets",
} as const;

export type OutputFormat = "pdf" | "html";

/**
 * POST /report body. Send ONE of:
 *  - `patient` + `tests` (template ids + results, built on the server)
 *  - `patient` + `profile`
 *  - `report` (an already built Report)
 *  - `sample` (demo id, only when the server enables samples)
 */
export interface ReportRequest {
  patient?: Patient;
  tests?: { template: TemplateId; results: Results }[];
  profile?: { id: ProfileId; results: Partial<Record<TemplateId, Results>> };
  report?: Report;
  sample?: string;
  /** default "header" */
  variant?: ReportVariant;
  /** default "sidebar" */
  design?: ReportDesign;
  /** default "pdf" */
  format?: OutputFormat;
  /** PDF only: send as a download with this name */
  fileName?: string;
  download?: boolean;
}

/** GET /templates */
export interface TemplateCatalog {
  templates: TemplateInfo[];
  profiles: { id: ProfileId; name: string; tests: TemplateId[] }[];
}
export interface TemplateInfo {
  id: TemplateId;
  name: string;
  category?: string;
  specimen?: string;
  method?: string;
  /** result keys to send in `tests[].results` */
  fields: { key: string; label: string; unit?: string; range?: string | string[] }[];
}

/** GET /samples (demo) */
export interface SampleInfo {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  group: "design" | "template" | "profile";
  source: string;
}

/** Error body for any non-2xx response */
export interface ApiError {
  error: string;
}
```

## File: src/server/api.ts

```ts
// Backend HTTP API for the report kit, built on the standard Fetch `Request`/`Response`, so it runs
// unchanged in Next.js route handlers, Hono, Bun, Deno — and in Express / node:http via toNodeHandler().
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { DEFAULT_BASE_PATH, ROUTES, type ReportRequest, type SampleInfo, type TemplateCatalog } from "../shared/api";
import type { LabProfile, Report } from "../shared/types";
import { renderLetterheadHtml, renderReportHtml } from "./html";
import { defaultLab } from "./signatures";
import { assetsDir } from "./paths";
import { renderLetterheadPdf, renderReportPdf } from "./pdf";
import { getSampleReport, SAMPLES } from "./samples";
import { buildProfileReport, buildReport, PROFILES, TEMPLATES, type ProfileId, type TemplateId } from "./templates";

export type ApiHandler = (req: Request) => Promise<Response>;

export interface ApiOptions {
  /** Where the handler is mounted (default "/api/mgpl") */
  basePath?: string;
  /** Lab branding (default: MGPL_LAB + private signatures from MGPL_SIGNATURE_* env vars) */
  lab?: LabProfile;
  /** Expose demo samples: GET /samples and `{ sample: id }` requests (default false) */
  samples?: boolean;
  /** Access-Control-Allow-Origin for browser clients on another origin, e.g. "https://app.example.com" or "*" */
  cors?: string;
  /** Max JSON body size in bytes (default 1 MB) */
  maxBodyBytes?: number;
  /** Public URL of this API when behind a proxy (default: taken from the request) */
  publicUrl?: string;
}

export class HttpError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public status: number,
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers */

export function json(body: unknown, status = 200, headers: HeadersInit = {}): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8", ...headers } });
}

export function pdfResponse(pdf: Buffer, fileName: string, download: boolean): Response {
  return new Response(new Uint8Array(pdf), {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/pdf",
      "Content-Disposition": `${download ? "attachment" : "inline"}; filename="${fileName.replace(/[^\w.-]+/g, "_")}"`,
      "Cache-Control": "no-store",
    },
  });
}

export function htmlResponse(html: string): Response {
  return new Response(html, { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
}

export async function readJson<T>(req: Request, maxBytes: number): Promise<T> {
  const len = Number(req.headers.get("content-length") ?? 0);
  if (len > maxBytes) throw new HttpError(413, `Body larger than ${maxBytes} bytes`);
  const text = await req.text();
  if (text.length > maxBytes) throw new HttpError(413, `Body larger than ${maxBytes} bytes`);
  try {
    return JSON.parse(text || "{}") as T;
  } catch {
    throw new HttpError(400, "Body must be JSON");
  }
}

/** The public URL prefix of this API, e.g. "https://lab.example.com/api/mgpl" */
export function apiBaseUrl(req: Request, opts: ApiOptions): string {
  const base = (opts.basePath ?? DEFAULT_BASE_PATH).replace(/\/$/, "");
  return (opts.publicUrl ?? new URL(req.url).origin + base).replace(/\/$/, "");
}

/** Lab profile whose "/report-assets/…" images point at this API's GET /assets route. */
export function labWithAssetUrls(lab: LabProfile, assetBase: string): LabProfile {
  const u = (src: string) => (src.startsWith("/report-assets/") ? `${assetBase}${src}` : src);
  return {
    ...lab,
    logoSrc: u(lab.logoSrc),
    qcStampSrc: lab.qcStampSrc && u(lab.qcStampSrc),
    icons: { emailSrc: u(lab.icons.emailSrc), phoneSrc: u(lab.icons.phoneSrc) },
    signatory: { ...lab.signatory, signatureHeaderSrc: u(lab.signatory.signatureHeaderSrc), signatureNonHeaderSrc: u(lab.signatory.signatureNonHeaderSrc) },
  };
}

const ASSET_TYPES: Record<string, string> = { svg: "image/svg+xml", png: "image/png", jpg: "image/jpeg", jpeg: "image/jpeg", woff: "font/woff" };

/** GET /assets/report-assets/<file> | /assets/report-fonts/<file> — the package's bundled files. */
export async function serveAsset(rel: string, cors?: string): Promise<Response> {
  const m = rel.match(/^\/(report-assets|report-fonts)\/([\w.-]+)$/);
  const type = m && ASSET_TYPES[m[2].split(".").pop()!.toLowerCase()];
  if (!m || !type) return json({ error: "Not found" }, 404);
  try {
    const data = await readFile(join(assetsDir(), m[1], m[2]));
    return new Response(new Uint8Array(data), {
      headers: { "Content-Type": type, "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=31536000, immutable", ...(cors ? { "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": cors } : {}) },
    });
  } catch {
    return json({ error: "Not found" }, 404);
  }
}

export function withCors(res: Response, cors?: string): Response {
  if (!cors) return res;
  const h = new Headers(res.headers);
  h.set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", cors);
  h.set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, OPTIONS");
  h.set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type, Authorization");
  h.set("Access-Control-Expose-Headers", "Content-Disposition");
  if (cors !== "*") h.append("Vary", "Origin");
  return new Response(res.body, { status: res.status, headers: h });
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- report API */

export function templateCatalog(): TemplateCatalog {
  return {
    templates: (Object.keys(TEMPLATES) as TemplateId[]).map((id) => {
      const t = TEMPLATES[id];
      return { id, name: t.name, category: t.category, specimen: t.specimen, method: t.method, fields: t.fields };
    }),
    profiles: (Object.keys(PROFILES) as ProfileId[]).map((id) => ({ id, name: PROFILES[id].name, tests: PROFILES[id].tests })),
  };
}

/** Turns a ReportRequest into a Report (throws HttpError 400 on bad input). */
export function reportFromRequest(body: ReportRequest, opts: Pick<ApiOptions, "samples"> = {}): Report {
  try {
    if (body.report) {
      if (!body.report.patient?.name || !Array.isArray(body.report.sections)) throw new Error("report needs patient.name and sections[]");
      return body.report;
    }
    if (body.sample) {
      if (!opts.samples) throw new Error("samples are disabled on this server");
      const r = getSampleReport(body.sample);
      if (!r) throw new Error(`unknown sample "${body.sample}"`);
      return r;
    }
    if (!body.patient?.name || body.patient.age == null || !body.patient.sex) throw new Error("patient needs name, age and sex");
    if (body.profile) return buildProfileReport(body.patient, body.profile.id, body.profile.results ?? {});
    if (Array.isArray(body.tests) && body.tests.length) return buildReport(body.patient, body.tests);
    throw new Error("send tests[], profile, report or sample");
  } catch (e) {
    throw new HttpError(400, (e as Error).message);
  }
}

/**
 * The report backend. Mount it at `basePath`:
 *
 *   // Next.js: app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts
 *   const api = createReportApi();
 *   export const GET = api, POST = api, OPTIONS = api;  export const runtime = "nodejs";
 *
 *   // Express / node:http
 *   app.use("/api/mgpl", toNodeHandler(createReportApi()));
 */
export function createReportApi(opts: ApiOptions = {}): ApiHandler {
  const base = (opts.basePath ?? DEFAULT_BASE_PATH).replace(/\/$/, "");
  const lab = opts.lab ?? defaultLab();
  const max = opts.maxBodyBytes ?? 1_000_000;

  return async (req) => {
    if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return withCors(new Response(null, { status: 204 }), opts.cors);
    let path = new URL(req.url).pathname;
    if (path.startsWith(base)) path = path.slice(base.length) || "/";
    try {
      const res = await route(req, path);
      return withCors(res, opts.cors);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof HttpError) return withCors(json({ error: e.message }, e.status), opts.cors);
      console.error("[@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit]", e);
      return withCors(json({ error: "Internal error" }, 500), opts.cors);
    }
  };

  async function route(req: Request, path: string): Promise<Response> {
    const get = req.method === "GET" || req.method === "HEAD";
    const q = new URL(req.url).searchParams;

    if (path.startsWith(ROUTES.assets + "/") && get) return serveAsset(path.slice(ROUTES.assets.length), opts.cors);
    if (path === ROUTES.health && get) return json({ ok: true, service: "report-kit" });
    if (path === ROUTES.templates && get) return json(templateCatalog());
    if (path === ROUTES.samples && get) {
      if (!opts.samples) throw new HttpError(404, "samples are disabled on this server");
      return json(SAMPLES.map((s): SampleInfo => ({ id: s.id, label: s.label, group: s.group, source: s.source })));
    }
    if (path === ROUTES.letterhead && get) {
      if (q.get("format") === "html") {
        const assetBase = apiBaseUrl(req, opts) + ROUTES.assets;
        return htmlResponse(await renderLetterheadHtml({ lab: labWithAssetUrls(lab, assetBase), inline: false, fontBase: `${assetBase}/report-fonts` }));
      }
      return pdfResponse(await renderLetterheadPdf({ lab }), "letterhead.pdf", q.get("download") === "1");
    }
    if (path === ROUTES.report) {
      if (req.method !== "POST") throw new HttpError(405, "Use POST");
      const body = await readJson<ReportRequest>(req, max);
      const report = reportFromRequest(body, opts);
      const variant = body.variant === "non-header" ? "non-header" : "header";
      const design = body.design === "classic" ? "classic" : "sidebar";
      if (body.format === "html") {
        const assetBase = apiBaseUrl(req, opts) + ROUTES.assets;
        return htmlResponse(
          await renderReportHtml({ report, variant, design, lab: labWithAssetUrls(lab, assetBase), inline: false, fontBase: `${assetBase}/report-fonts` }),
        );
      }
      const pdf = await renderReportPdf({ report, variant, design, lab });
      return pdfResponse(pdf, body.fileName ?? `${report.patient.patientId ?? "report"}-${variant}.pdf`, !!body.download);
    }
    throw new HttpError(404, `No route ${req.method} ${path}`);
  }
}
```

## File: src/server/signatures.ts

```ts
// Real signatures stay OUT of git. The public package ships a placeholder; a server points these
// environment variables at private image files and every report/invoice uses them automatically:
//
//   MGPL_SIGNATURE_FILE=/secure/signature.jpg            (both variants)
//   MGPL_SIGNATURE_HEADER_FILE=/secure/sig-scan.jpg      (header variant, overrides the above)
//   MGPL_SIGNATURE_NONHEADER_FILE=/secure/sig-green.png  (non-header variant, overrides the above)
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { extname, resolve } from "node:path";
import { MGPL_LAB } from "./lab";
import type { LabProfile } from "../shared/types";

const MIME: Record<string, string> = { ".png": "image/png", ".jpg": "image/jpeg", ".jpeg": "image/jpeg", ".svg": "image/svg+xml" };
const cache = new Map<string, string>();

/** A private image file as a data URI (usable in both the PDF and the HTML output). */
export function imageFileToDataUri(path: string): string {
  const abs = resolve(path);
  let uri = cache.get(abs);
  if (!uri) {
    const type = MIME[extname(abs).toLowerCase()];
    if (!type) throw new Error(`Signature must be .png, .jpg or .svg: ${path}`);
    uri = `data:${type};base64,${readFileSync(abs).toString("base64")}`;
    cache.set(abs, uri);
  }
  return uri;
}

/** Lab profile with signatures loaded from private files (undefined entries keep the current image). */
export function withSignatureFiles(lab: LabProfile, files: { header?: string; nonHeader?: string }): LabProfile {
  return {
    ...lab,
    signatory: {
      ...lab.signatory,
      signatureHeaderSrc: files.header ? imageFileToDataUri(files.header) : lab.signatory.signatureHeaderSrc,
      signatureNonHeaderSrc: files.nonHeader ? imageFileToDataUri(files.nonHeader) : lab.signatory.signatureNonHeaderSrc,
    },
  };
}

/** `lab` with signatures taken from the MGPL_SIGNATURE_* environment variables, if set. */
export function labFromEnv(lab: LabProfile = MGPL_LAB, env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env): LabProfile {
  const both = env.MGPL_SIGNATURE_FILE;
  const header = env.MGPL_SIGNATURE_HEADER_FILE ?? both;
  const nonHeader = env.MGPL_SIGNATURE_NONHEADER_FILE ?? both;
  return header || nonHeader ? withSignatureFiles(lab, { header, nonHeader }) : lab;
}

/** The lab used when none is passed: MGPL_LAB + private signatures from the environment. */
export const defaultLab = (): LabProfile => labFromEnv(MGPL_LAB);
```
